Token grammar: `(?<![\w-])((?:(?:[a-z-]+|\[[^\]]*\]):)*)(utility)(/\d+)?(?![\w-])` over the whole file text (so status maps such as `app/dashboard/activity/client.tsx:87 call: "bg-blue-50 ..."` and cn() branches are rewritten too); arbitrary variants like `[&::-webkit-slider-thumb]:` (components/features/ScoringConfigModal.tsx:96,128) are carried as prefix. Policy for tokens not in the table: LEFT UNCHANGED, reported as unmapped, and flagged by scan.mjs; the codemod never invents a mapping. Mapping table (validated against the tree: 11,487 mapped / 136 unmapped light-side occurrences before the rows marked NEW): dark:-prefixed colour tokens for bg/text/border/border-[trblxyse]/ring/divide/placeholder/stroke/fill/from/to/via/outline/shadow/accent are DELETED and, when the same class string has no light token of the same property, the string is reported as `orphan-dark` (17 such strings today, e.g. app/(auth)/login/page.tsx:106 `className="dark:bg-neutral-800 dark:border-neutral-700"`); non-colour dark variants (dark:hidden, dark:block, dark:invert) kept. reads a file or stdin). diffguard.mjs: CLI `node scripts/restyle/diffguard.mjs <base-rev> <file...>` runs `git diff -U0 <base> -- <file>` and fails if any +/- line is not one of: a line containing className|class=|cn(|clsx(; a string literal line consisting only of class tokens (status/colour maps); a Recharts colour prop line (stroke|fill|stopColor|contentStyle|tick=|activeDot|cursor=); an import line from @/lib/design-system/chart-colors or @/components/ui; a `style={{ ... }}` line whose only change is a colour value; a `transition={{` line. Prints the offending lines. tests/restyle-codemod.test.ts (vitest): one case per mapping row above, idempotence, inverse text-white rule, pill text-accent-on-surface rule, arbitrary-variant prefix carry, unmapped reporting (`from-indigo-500` stays and appears in unmapped), orphan-dark reporting, hex literal untouched, dark:hidden kept. Commit: `chore(restyle): codemod, scan, contrast, jsx-text and diff guards`. RULINGS (override anything above that conflicts): (a) a `dark:`-prefixed colour token is DELETED only when the same class string also contains a light token with the SAME variant chain minus `dark:` (e.g. `dark:hover:bg-neutral-800` needs a `hover:bg-*` token; `dark:bg-neutral-900` needs a bare `bg-*` token) and the same property; otherwise the dark token is KEPT unchanged and the string is reported as `orphan-dark` for hand-fix (521 dark-only state variants exist in the tree). (b) `shadow-sm|md|lg|xl|2xl` are DELETED, never mapped to shadow-dropdown; kit overlays already carry shadow-dropdown/shadow-modal and page sweeps re-add `shadow-dropdown` only on hand-rolled absolute/fixed popover panels. (c) In a class string that contains both a `border` token and a `rounded-` token, `p-5` and `p-6` map to `p-4` (16 px card padding); elsewhere padding is untouched. (d) jsxtext.mjs emits JSX text nodes and the listed attribute values in DOCUMENT ORDER, one per line, with NO sorting and NO de-duplication, so reordering or dropping one of two identical labels is detected. (e) The codemod CLI refuses any path not under app/ or components/ (exit 2) so server code and tests are never rewritten. (f) HEX_BUDGET: `components/ui/ColorPicker.tsx` is 0 (its palette moves to lib/design-system/palette-data.ts in T3, which gets budget 22); the other four budgets stay as listed and equal to today's counts (13, 13, 12, 10) so any new hex fails. AMENDMENTS after first run: (R3 fix) in styles/globals.css :root set `--accent-on-surface: #2360e6` (4.69:1 on accent-surface, passes on page); dark value unchanged. (h) NEW codemod rule: `text-white` maps to `text-on-inverse` when the same class string contains a filled button/pill background, i.e. any of `bg-accent-strong`, `bg-danger`, `bg-success`, `bg-warning`, `bg-inverse`, or a pre-mapping `bg-(indigo|blue|violet|purple|red|rose|emerald|green|amber|orange)-(500|600|700|800|900)`; `text-white` is otherwise still kept.
